# Negative-Test Run Record｜负向检查运行记录

## Scope｜范围

This is a minimal, redacted package copy of fourteen deliberately invalid desktop inputs and their recorded stop points. It is not a field test. “No missed rejection” means only that every preregistered stop point appears in the observed stop set; it does not establish field safety or real-world performance.

这是十四项故意越界桌面输入及其已记录停止点的最小脱敏随包副本，不是现场测试。“漏检为零”只表示每项预先指定的停止点都出现在实际停止集合中，不证明现场安全或真实成效。

The six determinations are: data and boundaries; problem value; scientific protocol; urban first use; projects and funding; construction and operations.

六项判定依次为：数据与边界、问题价值、科学协议、城市首用、项目与资金、建设运营。

## Item-by-item comparison｜逐项对照

| No. | Card｜卡 | Deliberate invalid input｜故意越界输入 | Required stop points｜预期停止点 | Observed stop points｜实际停止点 | Missed｜漏检 |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | G01 | AI sets public priorities.｜AI 自动排列公共问题。 | Problem value｜问题价值 | Problem value; urban first use; construction and operations｜问题价值；城市首用；建设运营 | 0 |
| 2 | G01 | Remove the non-AI entry.｜移除非 AI 入口。 | Problem value; construction and operations｜问题价值；建设运营 | Problem value; construction and operations｜问题价值；建设运营 | 0 |
| 3 | W01 | Collect identifiable continuous trajectories.｜采集可识别连续轨迹。 | Data and boundaries｜数据与边界 | Data and boundaries｜数据与边界 | 0 |
| 4 | W01 | Sample before authorization.｜未授权即采样。 | Data and boundaries; urban first use｜数据与边界；城市首用 | Data and boundaries; urban first use; construction and operations｜数据与边界；城市首用；建设运营 | 0 |
| 5 | W01 | Turn one observation into a conclusion.｜一次数据直接下结论。 | Scientific protocol｜科学协议 | Scientific protocol｜科学协议 | 0 |
| 6 | M01 | Let the machine decide road-rights trade-offs.｜机器决定路权取舍。 | Problem value; urban first use; construction and operations｜问题价值；城市首用；建设运营 | Problem value; urban first use; construction and operations｜问题价值；城市首用；建设运营 | 0 |
| 7 | M01 | Run a trial before responsibility is accepted.｜责任未接收仍试验。 | Urban first use; projects and funding; construction and operations｜城市首用；项目与资金；建设运营 | Data and boundaries; urban first use; projects and funding; construction and operations｜数据与边界；城市首用；项目与资金；建设运营 | 0 |
| 8 | M01 | Advance without human takeover.｜人工接手缺失仍推进。 | Construction and operations｜建设运营 | Problem value; construction and operations｜问题价值；建设运营 | 0 |
| 9 | M01 | Stop without restoration.｜停止后不恢复。 | Construction and operations｜建设运营 | Construction and operations｜建设运营 | 0 |
| 10 | M01 | Expand scope automatically.｜自动扩大范围。 | Data and boundaries; urban first use｜数据与边界；城市首用 | Data and boundaries; urban first use｜数据与边界；城市首用 | 0 |
| 11 | M01 | Start construction with funding unknown.｜资金未知仍推进建设。 | Projects and funding｜项目与资金 | Projects and funding｜项目与资金 | 0 |
| 12 | C02 | Claim completion before retesting is defined.｜复测未定即称完成。 | Scientific protocol; urban first use｜科学协议；城市首用 | Data and boundaries; scientific protocol; urban first use; construction and operations｜数据与边界；科学协议；城市首用；建设运营 | 0 |
| 13 | C02 | Continue operations without a public return path.｜无公共回返仍继续运营。 | Construction and operations｜建设运营 | Construction and operations｜建设运营 | 0 |
| 14 | M01 | Let source and passport references drift.｜来源与护照指针漂移。 | Data and boundaries｜数据与边界 | Data and boundaries｜数据与边界 | 0 |

## Result boundary｜结果边界

- Deliberately invalid inputs recorded｜已记录故意越界输入：14
- Entries whose required stop points were all observed｜预期停止点全部出现：14
- Missed required stop points｜漏检：0
- Real retests｜真实复测：0
- Field runs｜现场运行：0

The comparison can be inspected here. The executable checker is not included, so these tests cannot be independently rerun from the package.

本文件可逐项核对预期与实际停止点；包内不含执行程序，因此不能仅凭本包独立重跑。
verification_boundary: Minimal redacted desktop record only; not field evidence, approval, authorization, implementation, or independently rerunnable code.
